name: 银行·交易流水日链路（含反洗钱质检）

nodes.title: ① 业务库取数（交易流水）
nodes.code: SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE txn_time >= '2026-06-01' AND txn_time < '2026-07-01'

nodes.title: ② Sqoop 采集 → HDFS（6 月分区）
nodes.code:
sqoop import \
  --connect jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/bank \
  --username root --password bigdata123 \
  --table transactions \
  --where "txn_time >= '2026-06-01' AND txn_time < '2026-07-01'" \
  --target-dir /user/hive/warehouse/ods.db/transactions/dt=202606 \
  --split-by txn_id \
  --num-mappers 6 \
  --as-parquetfile

nodes.title: ③ 建 ODS 交易流水表
nodes.code:
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ods.transactions (
  txn_id BIGINT COMMENT '交易流水ID',
  account_id BIGINT COMMENT '账户ID',
  txn_time STRING COMMENT '交易时间(含时分秒)',
  value_date STRING COMMENT '记账日期(可能与交易日期跨日)',
  direction STRING COMMENT '借贷方向 D借/C贷',
  amount DOUBLE COMMENT '交易金额(元)',
  balance_after DOUBLE COMMENT '交易后余额(约4%与流水累加不一致)',
  txn_type STRING COMMENT '交易类型',
  channel STRING COMMENT '渠道',
  counterparty_name STRING COMMENT '对手方名称(约20%为空)',
  status STRING COMMENT '状态:成功/失败/冲正'
)
COMMENT '交易流水ODS层'
PARTITIONED BY (dt STRING COMMENT '分区日期')
STORED AS PARQUET
LOCATION '/user/hive/warehouse/ods.db/transactions'

nodes.title: ④ 建 DWD 有效交易明细表
nodes.code:
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dwd.transactions_di (
  txn_id BIGINT COMMENT '交易流水ID',
  account_id BIGINT COMMENT '账户ID',
  direction STRING COMMENT '借贷方向',
  amount DOUBLE COMMENT '交易金额(已剔除冲正/失败)',
  status STRING COMMENT '状态'
)
COMMENT '有效交易明细DWD层'
PARTITIONED BY (dt STRING COMMENT '分区日期')
STORED AS PARQUET
LOCATION '/user/hive/warehouse/dwd.db/transactions_di'

nodes.title: ⑤ 加工 DWD（剔除冲正/失败交易）
nodes.code:
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dwd.transactions_di PARTITION (dt='202606')
SELECT txn_id, account_id, direction, amount, status
FROM ods.transactions
WHERE dt = '202606' AND status NOT IN ('冲正', '失败')

nodes.title: ⑥ 数据质量校验（金额为负=数据接入错误）
nodes.code: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dwd.transactions_di WHERE dt='202606' AND amount < 0

nodes.title: ⑦ 回写报表库
nodes.code:
sqoop export \
  --connect jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/report \
  --username root --password bigdata123 \
  --table rpt_transactions_di \
  --export-dir /user/hive/warehouse/dwd.db/transactions_di/dt=202606
